svg.title: SekoTalk-H3 method overview
svg.desc: Two-stage training adapts MiniMax-H3 with Causal SFT and Self-Gradient-Forcing distillation. A persistent global prompt and reference image condition a causal audio-video transformer. Independently encoded motion prompts switch at chunk boundaries, illustrated by the same person speaking, raising a hand, and turning. The example shows six chunks with two chunks per motion segment. Each column aligns one sampled frame and its schematic audio chunk. MP1 starts at chunk k+2 and MP2 at k+4; segment lengths may vary. Within a chunk, denoising reads the active motion prompt; clean commit omits motion prompts and writes reusable media KV history. Both passes read retained clean history. The dashed return paths feed both passes of the next chunk. Photographic frames are AI-generated illustrations, not SekoTalk-H3 outputs. Audio waveforms are schematic.

g.text: Motion prompts · one active segment at a time
One frame per chunk shown. Segment lengths may vary.
